notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight Treasures.
description:
Activate eight Treasures you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating eight Treasure tokens and eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The eight Squirrel tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio that many times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
